data.description:
## Problem
After Gerrit 1796 lands, `src/rebar/llm/workflow/completion.py` sits at 800 LOC (the absolute CI cap) and `src/rebar/llm/workflow/completion_recovery.py` at 799. Any future change to either module must extract first or fails the module-size gate — the cap is already exerting design pressure (1796 PS3 had to trim comments to fit). These two modules carry the completion-verifier orchestration: gate resolution, snapshot pinning, criterion parsing, budget computation, banked recovery, finalizer merging, and cross-run cache seeding — too many concerns per unit.

## Goal (operator-directed)
Remediate BOTH modules together, architecturally — not a mechanical split to duck under the cap. Consider the cluster of logic surrounding each file; separate concerns and logical concepts into modules with clear contractual boundaries. Success = no future LOC pressure on individual modules, preserved readability, maintainability, reliability.

## Approach constraints (repo policy)
- Split ONLY along call-graph seams that already exist (extract clusters of functions that already call each other); never create files < 100 LOC; target 200-500 LOC per module.
- Behavior-preserving: no functional change; existing test suites are the oracle and must stay green unmodified (test moves/imports only where a module path changes).
- Complexity ratchet: extraction must not add branches; `python scripts/check_complexity_baseline.py --check` clean, never bump baselines.
- Map the concern clusters FIRST (e.g. candidate seams: snapshot/gate-handle resolution; budget arithmetic; bank lifecycle + seeding; finalizer merge/coverage validation; verdict assembly/annotation), then propose the module decomposition with each module's contract (what it owns, what it exposes) in the ticket before cutting code.
- Serena for reference sets + grep for string-named symbols on every moved symbol (monkeypatch.setattr sites in tests WILL break on moves — sweep them).

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Both modules and all extracted modules are 200-500 LOC (hard: none > 700 to leave headroom); no new module < 100 LOC.
- [ ] Decomposition plan (concern map + module contracts) recorded on this ticket before implementation.
- [ ] Zero behavior change: full completion/recovery/cache/budget test suites green without assertion edits (import-path updates only).
- [ ] All monkeypatch/getattr/string-referenced symbol sites swept (grep) and updated; no orphaned patch targets.
- [ ] `make lint` + `make typecheck` clean; complexity ratchet new=0 increased=0; module-size gate green.
- [ ] Lands via Gerrit (LLM-Review +1, Verified +1).
data.title: Decompose completion verifier orchestration modules (completion.py 800/completion_recovery.py 799 LOC at cap)
